ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of child care fraud in Minnesota and other states, and follow the money to determine who is benefiting from these schemes.
questions: What is the scope of child care fraud in Minnesota and other states?
Who is benefiting from these schemes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and corruption in the child care system, and to hold those responsible accountable.
